description.value: Ace Western Motel is a motel in Clearwater, British Columbia, providing accommodation for travelers in the area. Website verification was not possible at time of review due to connectivity issues.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website fetch failed (ConnectionError), so amenity verification relies entirely on OSM tags. OSM indicates a real motel with valid contact information and shows 'looks_closed: false'. Internet access (WLAN) is noted in OSM tags but cannot be confirmed without website access. All other amenities and specific bike-related services lack evidence.
concerns: Website could not be fetched (ConnectionError), limiting verification of amenities, current operation status, and OSM contact details. OSM tags claim WLAN but cannot be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real motel with complete OSM contact details. OSM indicates it does not appear closed. Website unavailability does not indicate business closure—this is a legitimate accommodation resource for touring cyclists.
